posts.title: Sir Lucian Grainge Is Right About Artist-Centric Streaming. Let’s Take the Next Step.
posts.description: Streaming should move beyond fixed royalty pools, giving artists freedom to negotiate per-stream prices, choose collective accounting, withhold releases, and pursue windowing. These options could better reward value, limit cross-subsidization, and strengthen competition amid AI-driven content growth.

posts.title: Eventually You Run Out of Other People’s Content: How Google May Win the AI Race But Lose on the AI Economics
posts.description: Google built one of the world’s most profitable businesses on other people’s content. Now it may be spending hundreds of billions of dollars to replace that business with one that generates far less.

posts.title: The AI Bubble Is Much Worse Than They Think: Remembering the Last War
posts.description: Ed Dowd's view that speculative bubbles lead to beneficial infrastructure is questionable. The detrimental consequences of the current AI investment boom exceed the benefits. While past bubbles created some lasting assets, AI's rapid obsolescence and environmental consequences may yield significant irreversible harm to communities and resources.
